profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack and Distributed Systems (Python, Go, Java)
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Hello LinkedIn community! 🚀 Thanks for taking a peek at my corner of the web. I am an experienced Software Engineer with over 6 years of focus on infrastructure scaling and distributed systems, delivering complex projects like vertical pod autoscaling for a distributed cache and a TTL system for a globally replicated NoSQL database, within fast-paced environments such as Datadog and Amazon.

I deliver expertise in the programming languages (Python, Go, Java), frameworks & libraries (Kubernetes, Temporal, Bazel, Helm), cloud & devops (AWS, GCP, Datadog, GItlab, Github), and databases (DynamoDB, Bigtable, and Redis) offering a strong foundation in software architecture and development. I am able to effectively navigate ambiguity, complexity and change when stakes and pressure are high, and lead without authority to overcome obstacles and ensure delivery.
